paths.name: Path of Conquest
paths.description: A mastery path focused on destroying your enemies

ability.name: Slice Through
ability.description: Crippling Blow will now hit 2 enemies within 15 feet of you, but your base damage is reduced by 50% and the snare potency is changed to 30%. Cooldown of Crippling Blow is increased to 10 seconds.

ability.name: To Glory!
ability.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
ability.description: You fill your group with purpose, causing all of your groupmates within 100 feet to regain 20 Action Points every 5 seconds. All enemies within 25 feet will lose 20 Action Points every 5 seconds.

ability.name: Overpowering Swing
ability.description: Arcing Swing will now additionally increase the target's chance to be critically hit by 10%.

ability.name: Myrmidia's Fury
ability.description: You slam into your target without remorse, dealing 208 damage every half second for 3 seconds.  This effect will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points. Myrmidia's Fury ignores 10% armor for each active Battle Command of Conquest.

ability.name: Runefang
ability.description: Whenever you parry an attack, your Strength and Weapon Skill will be increased by 160 for 10 seconds. This effect will not refresh itself.

ability.name: Staggering Impact
ability.description: Myrmidia's power bursts forth from you, slamming into all enemies within 25 feet.  All of the victims will suffer 425 damage over 10 seconds and have their chance to defend attacks reduced by 10%. The duration of Staggering Impact is increased by 4 seconds for each active Battle Command of Conquest.

ability.name: Nova Strike
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies in a line in front of you, up to 65 feet away, and an additional 1206 damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Press The Attack!
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
coreAbilities.description: You order your group to strike fiercely, increasing Strength by 100 for all groupmates within 100 feet.  All enemies within 25 feet will be frightened, reducing their Strength by 100.

coreAbilities.name: Precision Strike
coreAbilities.description: A careful strike that deals 209 damage, and ignores 15% of the victim's armor.

coreAbilities.name: Crippling Blow
coreAbilities.description: A cruel slash at your victim's legs which deals 171 damage and snares them, reducing their run speed by 40% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Shining Blade
coreAbilities.description: Your Shining Blade slices into your opponent for 209 damage.  For the next 5 seconds, Shining Blade will cause an additional 150 Elemental damage on the next damaging attack made by everyone in your group within 100 feet of you. If you are issuing a Battle Command of Conquest, for 5 seconds, your abilities will continue to deal an additional 75 Elemental damage.

coreAbilities.name: All Out Assault!
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
coreAbilities.description: You become filled with the endless power of Myrmidia, dealing 148 Elemental damage every 3 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Arcing Swing
coreAbilities.description: You sweep your blade out in a wide arc, dealing 109 damage to all enemies 25 feet in front of you, and reducing their Wounds by 100 for 20 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Vigilance
paths.description: A mastery path focused on hindering and crippling your foes

ability.name: Coordination
ability.description: Shield Rush and Sunder will now also increase your chance to parry by 20% for 20 seconds.

ability.name: To Victory!
ability.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
ability.description: You order your group to steady themselves, increasing the armor of your groupmates within 100 feet by 396.

ability.name: Dirty Tricks
ability.description: When you block, all members of your group within 100 feet except you will gain a 5% chance to critically hit for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Smashing Counter
ability.description: An overwhelming counterattack which deals 209 damage and knocks the victim down for 3 seconds. The chance of Smashing Counter being defended by the enemy is reduced by 10% for each active Battle Command of Vigilance.

ability.name: Laurels of Victory
ability.description: Vigilance also reduces critical damage taken by 20% on all group members within 100ft.

ability.name: Vigilance
ability.description: The glory of the sun fills you with power, reducing all damage that you take by 50% for 10 seconds but reducing all damage that you deal by 25%. The cooldown of Vigilance is reduced by 3 seconds for each active Battle Command of Vigilance.

ability.name: Flawless Defense
ability.description: Increase the chances to block, dodge, parry, and disrupt attacks by 50% for 10 seconds for all group members within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Sunder
coreAbilities.description: A smashing attack which deals 171 damage.  This attack causes monsters to hate you twice as much as normal.

coreAbilities.name: Stand Strong!
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
coreAbilities.description: You order your group to hold their positions, increasing Toughness by 100 for all groupmates within 100 feet.  All enemies within 25 feet will be frightened, reducing their Toughness by 100.

coreAbilities.name: Shield Rush
coreAbilities.description: A powerful forward slam with your shield which deals 246 damage to your enemy, and increases your chance to block by 10% for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: On Your Guard!
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
coreAbilities.description: You order your group to ready their defenses, causing 225 damage back against any attacker who strikes a groupmate within 100 feet with a melee attack. Targets can only be damaged once every two seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Perseverance
coreAbilities.description: The blessings of Myrmidia fill you, increasing your Armor by 594 for 10 seconds.  Whenever you're attacked during this time, you will regain 10 Action Points. If you are issuing a Battle Command of Vigilance, you additionally increase the Wounds of all group members within 100 feet by 50 for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Repel Darkness
coreAbilities.description: The power of the sun blasts your enemy away, dealing 209 damage and knocking them away from you.

paths.name: Path of Glory
paths.description: A mastery path focused on supporting and bolstering you and your allies

ability.name: Sunfury
ability.description: Shield Of The Sun will now deal 225 damage back against enemies, and Vicious Slash's cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

ability.name: Now's Our Chance!
ability.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
ability.description: You fill your enemies with fear and doubt, causing all healing abilities to become 75% as effective when used by any enemies within 25 feet of you.

ability.name: Focused Mending
ability.description: Stay Focused! will now also cause groupmates in the area to receive 15% more from all healing effects used on them.

ability.name: Heaven's Fury
ability.description: A blazing aura of light surrounds your blade as you bring it around in a broad sweep, dealing 105 Elemental damage to all enemies in front of you up to 40 feet away.  Everyone hit by this attack will be staggered, and unable to move for 4 seconds, preventing all actions unless they are damaged. The duration of Heaven's Fury is increased by 0.5 seconds for each active Battle Command of Glory.

ability.name: Destroy Confidence
ability.description: Shatter Confidence will now remove one additional Enchantments or Blessings from the victim, dealing damage for each one that was removed.

ability.name: Unbalancing Attack
ability.description: A powerful strike which knocks your enemy off-balance, dealing 209 damage and causing the victim to lose 40 Action Points. All members of your group within 50 feet gain 20 Action Points. Allies gain an additional 10 Action Points for each active Battle Command of Glory.

ability.name: Solar Flare
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet.  Enemy players hit by this effect will lose 1800 points of Morale.

coreAbilities.name: Blazing Blade
coreAbilities.description: The force of the sun fills your blade, dealing 142 damage to the enemy and the victim will also suffer 258 Elemental damage over the next 9 seconds. This effect is stackable up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Gather Your Resolve!
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
coreAbilities.description: You order your group to steady their thoughts, increasing all resistances by 240 for all groupmates within 100 feet.  All enemies within 25 feet will be frightened, reducing their resistances by 120.

coreAbilities.name: Vicious Slash
coreAbilities.description: You slice deeply into your enemy, dealing 142 damage to the enemy and interrupting any abilities that they are building up.  The victim will also suffer an additional 300 damage over 5 seconds. If an ability was interrupted, the target will be cursed, lowering their Initiative by 150 over 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Shatter Confidence
coreAbilities.description: You crush your enemy's will, removing 1 Enchantment from them.  If an Enchantment is successfully removed, then the victim will also suffer 246 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Stay Focused!
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Battle Commands at a time
coreAbilities.description: You order your group to prepare for combat, causing all of your groupmates within 100 feet to regain 180 health over 3 seconds any time they defend themselves against an attack.

coreAbilities.name: Shield of the Sun
coreAbilities.description: The heat of the very sun itself surrounds you for 10 seconds, dealing 150 Elemental damage back to anyone that attacks you. Targets can only be damaged once every two seconds. If you are issuing a Battle Command of Glory, you surround group members within 50 feet with a barrier, absorbing up to 937 damage over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Deflect Oil
coreAbilities.description: 50% reduction in damage taken by Oil siege engines. You will also protect two other group mates within 30 feet. Only one effect of this type may be on a player at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Modify War Engine
coreAbilities.description: You shield the Ram absorbing 1500 damage over the next 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bulwark
coreAbilities.description: Repairs a friendly keep door for 5% of its total health over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Throw Blade
coreAbilities.description: A basic throwing attack that inflicts 81 damage. Has a chance to deal 680 damage to a severely wounded target if you are behind them.

coreAbilities.name: Guard
coreAbilities.description:
You defend one of your groupmates and try to take attacks meant for them.  As long as you are within 30 feet of them, any damage that they suffer will be split evenly between the two of you, and 35% of all hate that they cause will be redirected to you.

Damage received from this ability can be blocked or parried, unless the original attack was undefendable.

coreAbilities.name: Taunt
coreAbilities.description:
You enrage your opponent, interrupting any currently building abilities and increasing their hate towards you. While taunted your opponent will take 30% more damage from your attacks. This effect will fade after 15 seconds or after your opponent has hit you 3 times.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Demolishing Strike
coreAbilities.description: A powerful melee attack that reduces  your target's armor by 1056 and deals 900 damage over 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Emperor's Ward
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will become protected by a magical barrier for up to 10 seconds, which will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hold The Line!
coreAbilities.description:
You focus your defenses against enemy fire, increasing your chances to dodge and disrupt by 45% for 12 seconds.  You will also defend all allies behind you, up to 50 feet away, increasing their chances to dodge and disrupt by 15% as long as they remain at your back.  Allies may have this effect stacked on them up to 3 times.
This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: You become filled with unstoppable power, removing all snaring, rooting, silencing, and disarming effects. For the next 5 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Shield Wall
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, your chance to block is almost guaranteed.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Offense
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 15% more damage and all enemy monsters will hate you 15% less than normal, but your armor is reduced by 33%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Rugged
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Champion's Challenge
coreAbilities.description:
Both you and your target are held tightly in place for 10 seconds, and neither one of you can move.
This effect cannot be dispelled or broken.

coreAbilities.name: Challenge
coreAbilities.description: You challenge all opponents in front of you, forcing monsters to attack you. While challenged, your opponents will deal only 70% damage to everyone other than you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Unwavering Faith
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Spirit resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Shackle
coreAbilities.description: Your cowardly enemies are forced to face your wrath.  Up to 4 enemies within 25 feet are rooted in place, making them unable to move for 5 seconds.  Rooted targets have a 50% chance to break free when they suffer damage.

coreAbilities.name: Raze
coreAbilities.description: You repeatedly attack all enemies in a line in front of you, inflicting 300 damage every second  for 3 seconds, up to 65 feet away, for as long as you maintain your concentration.

coreAbilities.name: Gilded Shield
coreAbilities.description: Increases your chance to disrupt attacks by 15% as long as you're holding a shield.

coreAbilities.name: Sigmar's Favor
coreAbilities.description: Any time that you are healed by a direct heal, there is a 25% chance that you will regain an additional 135 hit points as well.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Bellow
coreAbilities.description: A loud shout that startles your target and all enemies within 25 feet of them, reducing their damage to 60% for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Menace
coreAbilities.description: Enemy monsters will hate you 100% more than normal on all attacks.

coreAbilities.name: Biting Blade
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy, they will suffer an additional 390 damage over 10 seconds and their parry chance will be reduced by 5%.

coreAbilities.name: Efficient Swings
coreAbilities.description: Detaunts are dispelled automatically when applied to you.

coreAbilities.name: Guardian of Light
coreAbilities.description: You become surrounded by a protective barrier for up to 30 seconds which will absorb up to 3600 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: Juggernaut's cooldown is reduced to 40 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sun's Blessing
coreAbilities.description: Shield Of The Sun and Perseverance will have their cooldown time reduced by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Emperor's Champion
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength, Toughness, and Wounds by 250 for 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Well-Trained
coreAbilities.description: Smashing Counter, Shield Rush, and Vicious Slash no longer cost action points.

coreAbilities.name: Banish Darkness
coreAbilities.description: Reduces the cooldown of Repel Darkness by 50%. If wielding a Great Weapon, Repel Darkness additionally snares the target by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: No Escape
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies within 10 feet and roots them, making them unable to move for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bellow Commands
coreAbilities.description: Battle Commands will restore 5 action points every second for each of your active Battle Commands.

coreAbilities.name: Immaculate Defense
coreAbilities.description: An impressive display of defense which reduces incoming damage by 75% for both you and all group members within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.
